name: DIPSAC Free API
free_limit: 500 API requests/month; 2 requests/second; 5 MB files; 1 API key
watch_out: The 500-request monthly API quota is separate from unlimited browser tools. The pricing comparison also lists limited Free AI Voice Studio usage (20 speech/transcription generations per day, 1,000 characters per take, 3 minutes per file); do not claim all audio/video features are excluded or that paid video transcription is included. API quota exhaustion returns HTTP 429; unused monthly API requests do not roll over. Commercial-use rights are unconfirmed.
